lines.en: The flowerbed hums all around me.
The wind over the flower field is warm.

lines.zh: 花海的橙，飞起来最显眼。
lines.en: My orange shows best over a flower field.

lines.zh: 花海的风往哪吹，我就往哪去。
lines.en: Where the flower-field wind blows, I follow.
The black veins on my wings look like a map.
I fly lighter than yesterday.
Who knocked the nectar over?

lines.zh: 这一路的水草，缠得真多。
lines.en: So much seagrass tangling this whole way.
The swamp's undercurrent is truly annoying.

lines.zh: 花海这么大，我翅膀有点累。
lines.en: The flower field is huge; my wings are tired.
Slow down; do not disturb this flower field.
Something crawls beneath the petals.
The flowers sway; I keep going.
The flower field path — I circled back.

lines.zh: 这片花田，我闭眼都认得。
lines.en: I know this flower field blind.
Pollen clings all over me.
In the dew, my wings glint.
I'm counting this flower's petals.
Which flower shall I visit today?
I should probably switch flowers.

lines.zh: 我停在一朵白花上歇翅。
lines.en: I rest my wings on a white bloom.
This flowerbed is like a little city.
The water in the flower field shines sweet.
The wind pushes; I stay on the flower's heart.
How many bees have I counted?

lines.zh: 橙色的翅在阳光下，像一小片火。
lines.en: My orange wings look like a scrap of fire.
Everyone knows these orange and black markings.
The canopy's shadow has moved on.
The grass heads sway slowly in the wind.
One dewdrop bursts, then another.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的样子，吓跑蜜蜂了。
lines.en: Your bending scares the bees away.
You're neither flower nor tree.

lines.zh: 你走路很轻，可还是踩了花。
lines.en: You step lightly, but still crush flowers.

lines.zh: 我该落你肩上，还是飞走？
lines.en: Land on your shoulder, or fly off?
I can see the net in your hand.
The orange on my wings is a warning.
Don't step on that patch of daisies.
How long can you stand still?
You're tall, like a tree that won't move.
My wings shine a little brighter than the lake.

lines.zh: 我被打得转了两圈，才停住。
lines.en: The blow spun me twice before I stopped.
One of my antennae is bent.
My wings aren't dry yet.

lines.zh: 轻点，我的翅膀一碰就破。
lines.en: Careful; my wings tear at a touch.
Why does the nectar taste of iron?
A split runs across my wing membrane.
Dust on my wings slows my flight.
You've hurt my wings.
Wings wet, I fall to the ground.
I need to get higher.
Who spilled this much nectar?
The nectar smells sweet; your hand is huge.
The sweetness circles my antennae.
That petal — I'm not done looking.
May I land on your fingertip?
That flower — I do want it.

lines.zh: 花海里的虫鸣，我听见了。
lines.en: The insects in the flower field; I hear them.
My orange wings caught a little nectar.
Hold out the flower and I circle you.

lines.zh: 橘黑的翅膀，花海一眼认出。
lines.en: Orange and black, the meadow knows me.
Your shoulder feels like stone.
I ride the wind all day without landing.

lines.zh: 花海里挤，你比花茎还硬。
lines.en: The flower field is crowded, and you're stiffer than stems.
I nearly pitched into the mud.

lines.zh: 花海这头到那头，一天够我飞。
lines.en: One field to the next — a day's flight.
The flower fields are vast; I drift slowly.
Hey — you hit my wings!
My scales dust the whole path.
You've knocked the petals loose.
I'm knocked into a somersault.

lines.zh: 我在花茎上结了个小巢。
lines.en: I built a little nest on a stem.
The eggs will cling under a leaf.

lines.zh: 这片花海，我给你留了一角。
lines.en: I saved you a corner of this flower field.
Orange and black suits your pattern.
This clump of flowers is ours.
Just touch wingtips.

lines.zh: 黑脉金斑蝶，记住了这名字。
lines.en: Monarch; remember that name.
There's nectar enough; no rush.
I fly a circle around you.

lines.zh: 花海的橙，是我一点点飞的。
lines.en: I fly the flower sea a wingbeat at a time.

lines.zh: 花海的风把东西吹来了。
lines.en: The flower field wind blew this over.
I carry it low.
A seed — far too hard.

lines.zh: 也许这东西能派上用场。
lines.en: This might come in handy.
It feels like dried resin.
Bees will like this color.
The wind brings a petal.
Too much pollen; my wings feel heavy.
I landed on this drop first.
A small blue petal is mine.
When I land, the flower sways.
The fullest bloom.
I've waited all morning.
My wings have closed.
The flower field is only so big.

lines.zh: 你的帽子在花丛里太显眼。
lines.en: Your hat stands out in the flowers.
Over the flower field I fly slowest of all.
When the wind stops, I drop.
I perch on the highest flower.
The one on the leaf tip is alone.
I'm set on this flower.
Your steps are slowing.

lines.zh: 你踩倒的那朵花还在晃。
lines.en: The flower you crushed is still swaying.
The stem is getting closer.
There's nowhere to hide in the flowers.
I know these parts with my eyes shut.
My wings aren't tired yet.

lines.zh: 花海的橙翅，一路跟着你。
lines.en: Orange wings from the meadow follow you.
Chasing you beats chasing bees.
I've landed on your shoulder — hold still.
Catch this puff of pollen.
Your hand is quick; my wings are quicker.
This flower field answers to me.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖扫过你的鼻子。
lines.en: My wingtip brushes across your nose.

lines.zh: 花海里的翅，还能再扇一次。
lines.en: These meadow wings can flap once more.
Don't pinch my wings.
Stay away from that patch of white blooms.

lines.zh: 我翅上的粉，沾了你一手。
lines.en: My wing dust is on your hand.
Leave this flower field.
Scale dust is on your face now.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀还是软的，先晾一晾。
lines.en: My wings are still soft; I let them dry.
I hear buzzing in the distance.

lines.zh: 花海的光，把我的翅膀照亮。
lines.en: The flower field light lights up my wings.
One gust and I switch flowers.
Where am I? Flowers everywhere.
Any bees? Hopefully not.
The sun is warm; perfect for spreading wings.
I've just landed in this field.
Let's begin with this flower.
My wings aren't dry yet.
Hot! The petals are curling!
Orange and black wings, dusted with sand.
A butterfly should not fall into water.
Pollen fills the air from the blast.
Your arrow grazes my wing.
This pain is wrong, it is sorcery.
The flowers have withered; I'm spent.

lines.zh: 我的翅被雷声震得发抖。
lines.en: Thunder leaves my wings trembling.

lines.zh: 这里没有底，我一直在往下坠。
lines.en: No bottom here, and I keep falling.
